summary: This plugin manages a searchable catalog of discovered skills and plugins, and when requested by the user, orchestrates existing installers to update related capability documentation and install status.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Based on repository metadata and README, this plugin is primarily an orchestration and automation tool for agent capability management: it discovers skills/plugins, builds and maintains a searchable Chinese catalog, and optionally coordinates existing trusted installers when users explicitly request installation. It also provides CLI workflows for search/filter/diff/status tasks and updates local catalog/profile files, while not presenting independent code generation, data analytics, or media processing as its core function.
